breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The original prompt specified a time domain of t in [0, 1.0] but requested an output at T=1.1. The ground truth resolves this by setting the final time to T=1.0. The agent correctly identified this conflict and set the final time to T=1.0 in the generated specification: 'Nt = ceil(T/dt0) with T = 1.0'.
